description: Run an analysis case or calc once per row of a parameter sweep (the RunSweep RPC, the CLI's -sweep): each row an ordinary run with the swept parameters bound to that row's values, stepped through the ranges' cartesian product or drawn with samples and seed. A failed row is a row with `error`, not a failed table. Bounded by the service's OPENSYSML_MAX_* budgets. The result is the RunSweepResponse as protojson writes it; the text is the table.

arguments.description: positional values every row binds, each a protojson Value. Example arms: {"intValue":"7"}, {"realValue":1.5}, {"boolValue":true}, {"stringValue":"x"}, {"quantity":{"realMagnitude":5.0,"unit":"m"}}, {"enumLiteral":{"literalId":"Colors::red"}}

engine.description: the analysis engine asked; empty is auto

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

namedArguments.description: values every row binds by name, each a protojson Value. Example arms: {"intValue":"7"}, {"realValue":1.5}, {"boolValue":true}, {"stringValue":"x"}, {"quantity":{"realMagnitude":5.0,"unit":"m"}}, {"enumLiteral":{"literalId":"Colors::red"}}

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

ranges.description: the ranges swept, each a protojson SweepRange {"parameter":name,"start":Value,"end":Value,"step":Value}; several make one row per point of their cartesian product

samples.description: rows to draw uniformly from each range instead of stepping through it; 0 steps, above 0 needs seed and refuses a range with a step

seed.description: seed the draws are taken from; required with samples

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

subjectSymbolId.description: qualified name of a part/usage to instantiate as an analysis case's subject, or a path from one

symbolId.description: qualified name of the analysis case or calc, definition or usage

name: run_sweep
